events.title: 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 further boost their promotion bid with the £150,000 acquisition of QPR defender Glenn Roeder , while Terry Neill makes a last-ditch attempt to reverse 아스널 's dismal league form by signing 21-year-old 맨체스터 시티 defender Tommy Caton for £500,000.

The pressure mounts further on 아스널 manager Terry Neill after a 1–0 defeat at home to 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 leaves his side 15th in the First Division. Leaders 리버풀 are now four points ahead at the top of the table after a 1–0 win over 버밍엄 시티, as 맨체스터 유나이티드 lose 1–0 at home to 에버턴 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 are beaten 1–0 by 애스턴 빌라 at Villa Park . 코번트리 시티 keep up the pressure on the leading pack with a 4–2 away win over 루턴 타운. 왓퍼드 climb out of the bottom three with a 5–0 away win over 울버햄프턴 원더러스.
노팅엄 포리스트 beat their East Midlands rivals 레스터 시티 3–2 in a First Division clash at the City Ground , lifting the hosts up from 11th place to sixth.

에버턴 boost their chances of ending their 14-year wait for a major trophy by beating 웨스트햄 유나이티드 2–0 in a League Cup fourth round replay at Goodison Park . In the Second Division, 첼시 boost their promotion push and increase Swansea's relegation worries with a 6–1 win at Stamford Bridge.

왓퍼드's UEFA Cup quest ends in a 7-2 aggregate defeat to Sparta Prague in the third round. 노팅엄 포리스트 progress to the quarter-finals with a 2–1 win over 셀틱 at Parkhead , after the first leg at the City Ground ended in a goalless draw. On the domestic scene, 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 take 맨체스터 유나이티드 to a second replay in the League Cup third round after a 1–1 draw at Old Trafford.

코번트리 시티 achieve one of the most surprising results of the season by defeating league champions 리버풀 4–0 at Highfield Road . Striker Terry Gibson scores a hat-trick. The defeat cuts 리버풀's lead at the top of the First Division to a single point following victories for both 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 맨체스터 유나이티드. Coventry are now fourth and just three points off the top of the table. QPR climb from ninth to fifth with a 2–1 away win over 웨스트브로미치 앨비언. 노츠 카운티 stay clear of the relegation zone after another rout, this time beating 선덜랜드 6–1 at Meadow Lane . 루턴 타운 remain in touch with the leading pack by winning 4–2 at 스토크 시티. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are now nine points adrift of safety after losing 6–1 to 레스터 시티 at Filbert Street. 아스널 are just five points clear of the relegation zone after losing 3–1 at 웨스트햄 유나이티드. In the Second Division, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 허더즈필드 타운 5–2 on Tyneside to return to the top three at the expense of 맨체스터 시티, who lose 2–1 at home to leaders 셰필드 웬즈데이.
Brazilian club Grêmio wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄 by defeating West Germany's 함부르크 2–1 in extra-time. The winning goal is scored by Renato Gaúcho .
Telford United beat Football League opposition in the FA Cup for the second time this season, beating 노샘프턴 타운 3–2 at home.
Terry Neill is sacked after more than seven years as manager of 아스널, who occupy 16th place in the First Division. 맨체스터 유나이티드 go top of the league with a 4–2 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼.

리버풀 return to the top of the First Division with a 5–0 home win over 노츠 카운티. 애스턴 빌라 keep up the pressure on the leading pack with a 4–0 home win over 입스위치 타운. Caretaker manager Don Howe begins his spell in charge of 아스널 with a 3–1 home win over 왓퍼드. 코번트리 시티 miss the chance to close the gap on the leaders with a goalless draw at 노리치 시티. QPR go fourth with a 2–0 home win over 에버턴.
루턴 타운 are sixth in the First Division and just five points behind the leaders after beating 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 2–0 at Kenilworth Road .
아스널 sell misfit striker Lee Chapman to 선덜랜드 for £200,000. 맨체스터 유나이티드 bow out of the League Cup after losing their second third round replay 2–1 to 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 at the Manor Ground .
리버풀's bid for a fourth successive League Cup triumph continues when they draw 1–1 with 버밍엄 시티 in the fourth round.
리버풀 beat 버밍엄 시티 3–0 in the League Cup fourth round replay at Anfield.
Griffin Park is the scene of the last league action before Christmas, with struggling 브렌트퍼드 losing 4–3 at home to a 윔블던 side pushing for a second successive promotion.

Boxing Day drama in the First Division sees 리버풀 extend their lead to three points with a 2–1 away win over 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, while 맨체스터 유나이티드 are held to a 1–1 draw at Coventry. 루턴 타운 go third with a 3–0 away win over 노츠 카운티. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 are now 10 points adrift of safety and have still only won one of their first 19 games, going down 3–1 at 입스위치 타운. 아스널's recovery continues as they triumph 4–2 over 토트넘 홋스퍼 in the North London derby at White Hart Lane .

울버햄프턴 원더러스 gain their first home win of the season with a 3–0 victory against 에버턴 , while 맨체스터 유나이티드 throw away a two-goal lead to draw 3–3 with struggling 노츠 카운티 in a bad-tempered match featuring nine yellow cards for the East Midlanders.
노팅엄 포리스트 are five points off the top of the First Division after beating 코번트리 시티 3–0 at the City Ground.

The year draws to a close with 리버풀 still top of the First Division by a three-point margin over 맨체스터 유나이티드, having beaten 노팅엄 포리스트 1–0 at the City Ground, while Ron Atkinson 's men keep up the pressure with a 1–0 home win over 스토크 시티. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 go third with a 4–1 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼 at Upton Park. 울버햄프턴 원더러스 make it back-to-back victories and are now just five points adrift of safety after a 2–0 home win over 노리치 시티. 첼시 go top of the Second Division with a 1–0 home win over Brighton.
